intro: bash-language-server 5.6.0 (node v23.6.1, ShellCheck 0.11.0 on PATH, shfmt not installed). Its own `--help` names no setting beyond `BASH_IDE_LOG_LEVEL`; its README points to `config.ts`, whose settings are in the bundled `out/config.js` (environment variable in the second column). Each setting was run once, over the suite cases that fail by default (37 cases whose method it advertises; the 18 cases of methods it does not advertise cannot change) and over the 28 originals. Only `INCLUDE_ALL_WORKSPACE_SYMBOLS` was also run over the whole suite, so only its Lost column is a full measurement; for the others "not measured" means no passing suite case was re-run. Default result: originals 11 / 28, suite 101 / 155. The tool table above uses the default settings.

runs.note: Suite 96 / 155 (default 101), originals 11 / 28 (same total). Net worse: with every workspace symbol in view, names resolve across unrelated files. Result: `suite-bls-includeall-m4.json`.
